messages:
Nina: Heads-up — during yesterday's image bake we noticed missing audit entries for the image-signing step (signer-service account). Noticed a 2h gap in cloud audit logs around 03:10-05:10 UTC.
Sam: Yikes. Which project/bucket?
Nina: project:redwood-builds, bucket:images-archive. The cosign invocation ran but there was no KMS decrypt log for the signing key.
security-bot: [alert] 2025-11-18T03:12Z COSIGN_KMS_DECRYPT_FAILED signer-service (err: PermissionDenied)
Oliver: Could be RBAC on the KMS key or a temporary DB/service account rotation. Any recent iam:roles changes?
Priya: I pushed a permissive iam binding for builder role last week for a new CI lane — might be related.
Maya: If the signer-service lost kms:decrypt on the key, cosign would log but the signing binary might fallback and buffer, leaving no audit call. Need to assume compromise window until proven otherwise.
Devon: Oncall triage: rolling audit now. Sam, can you run an access check and dump the key IAM policy?
Sam: Running. Paste expected command for reproducibility:

Sam: ```
# gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/images/cryptoKeys/sign-key --format=json
```

Sam: Output (sanitized): ```
{"bindings":[{"role":"roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter","members":["serviceAccount:signer-service@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com","serviceAccount:old-builder@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com"]},{"role":"roles/owner","members":["user:infra-admin@redwood.com"]}]}
```

Nina: That old-builder account should NOT be in encrypter/decrypter. I thought we removed it during the last RBAC audit.
Priya: Right — that was supposed to be removed. Looks like the removal didn't propagate to the live key due to a retry bug in infra-iam-runner.
Maya: Proposed immediate mitigations: 1) remove old-builder from key binding 2) rotate key/issue new version and update cosign KMS key resource 3) run a signed-canary bake to make sure signing works and logs show decrypt events 4) preserve all artifacts and logs for forensics.
Devon: Agreed. Also open an incident with severity 2 for the gap and notify legal if artifacts show any unusual access.
Oliver: For the RBAC change I'd like a short maintenance window: remove binding, wait 5m, check logs, then rotate. If anything fails we rollback by re-adding old-builder.
Sam: I'll prepare the iam change as an IAP PR and add a small automation check. Diff snippet: ```
- members: serviceAccount:old-builder@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com
+ # removed old-builder
```

Sam: Scheduling the PR to merge in 15m into infra-iam. Tagging @Maya for approval.
Maya: Approve — but require infra to sign off on the rollback play. Also require an audit export of cloudkms.access and cloudkms.activity for 24h window.
Priya: I'll export logs to gs://redwood-forensics/kms-20251118 and set retention to 90d for the bucket. Command: ```
# gcloud logging sinks create kms-forensics gs://redwood-forensics/kms-20251118 --log-filter="resource.type=cloudkms_key AND timestamp>\"2025-11-18T02:00:00Z\"" --unique-writer-identity
```

Nina: After rotation, we should also update the console's per-route tracing so we can see token->signer correlation in the future. Current gaps made it hard to map job ids to signing attempts.
Maya: Good call. Add a trace id (TRACE_ID env) to the cosign wrapper and log it in both build job and signer-service.
Oliver: For canary: I'll do a 5-image canary on staging, then 50 on a subset of dedicated nodes before full cutover. If any missing decrypt logs, stop and rollback.
Devon: Add remediation checklist for the oncall runbook: snapshot signing key policy, rotate if weird ACLs, preserve container images, run vulnerability scan on builder image, and notify customers if any images are re-signed.
Nina: Also ensure our KMS key's IAM role is restricted to a new group: image-signers@redwood.gservice — don't allow long-lived builder accounts.
Sam: PR merged. IAM removal applied at 2025-11-18T03:35Z.
security-bot: [info] 2025-11-18T03:36Z IAM_CHANGE applied by infra-automation
Sam: Initiating key rotation: ```
# gcloud kms keys versions create --key=sign-key --purpose=encryption
# gcloud kms keys set-iam-policy ... (apply image-signers group)
```

Priya: Rotation done. Verified decrypt logs: 3 entries at 03:42, 03:43, 03:45. Sample: ```
2025-11-18T03:42Z cloudkms.googleapis.com decrypt projects/... requestPrincipal:serviceAccount:signer-service@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```

Maya: Forensics notes: no unexpected principals seen in decrypt logs aside from signer-service and infra-admin service account. Continue with canary.
Oliver: Canary 5 images on staging passed. 50 on canary pool in 20m. Will update thread with failures.
Devon: Filing incident ticket INF-2025-0940 (severity 2). Adding timeline and remediation steps.
Nina: Thanks team. Postmortem once we confirm no further gaps. Quick follow-ups: (a) audit infra-iam-runner retry logic (b) add unit test to block stale bindings (c) instrument cosign wrapper with TRACE_ID.
Maya: I'll own postmortem and compliance brief.
security-bot: [resolve] 2025-11-18T05:12Z CANARY_COMPLETE status=ok
Oliver: Canary on canary-pool finished clean. Rolling to prod after 10m observation.
Nina: Closing thread for now — will reopen if anything odd. Thanks.
